overview_description.description:
UnitedMasters gives musicians an alternative to exploitative record label deals.

Artists pay UnitedMasters a competitive rate to distributes their music across the internet from Spotify to YouTube to SoundCloud, and they split the royalties while the artist retains the rights to the master recordings.

The Brooklyn, New York-based music company was established by Steve Stoute in 2017.

about_short_description.short_description: UnitedMasters is a technology platform that gives musicians an alternative to exploitative record label deals.

product.name: Digital Music Distribution
product.description: A service that enables independent artists to distribute their music to over 50 digital music platforms worldwide while retaining full ownership of their master recordings and royalties.

product.name: Brand & Sync Licensing Deals
product.description: A service that connects artists with brand partnerships and sync opportunities to place their music in movies, TV shows, advertisements, and other media.

product.name: Artist Marketing and Promotion Tools
product.description: Tools and automated campaigns designed to help artists promote their music, grow their fan base, and reach audiences across digital platforms.

product.name: Real-Time Royalties and Wallet Management
product.description: A system that tracks streaming royalties in real time and allows artists to manage and cash out their earnings through a digital wallet.

product.name: Artist Development with Blueprint AI
product.description: A personalized artist development service that uses AI to provide career guidance and growth strategies for independent musicians.
